note: Facts taken from Navneet's sponsorship proposal (December 2026 - May 2027). The /sponsor and /about pages are built from this file, so both assistants can correct a number here rather than hunting through the pages. Contact details are deliberately absent: this repository is public.
source: Navneet Kumar · Kanyakumari to Kashmir Sponsorship Proposal

person.studying: Third year, BA English Honours, APS University, Rewa
person.halfMarathons: Two run, a third on 9 August 2026

record.claim: Attempting to become the youngest person to walk from Kanyakumari to Kashmir
caveats: No records body currently maintains a category for the youngest person to walk this route.
Guinness recognises a fastest journey on foot between Kashmir and Kanyakumari, not a youngest one. An application is pending and unanswered.
A walker named Rakshit Shrivastava states he walked Ladakh to Kanyakumari - a longer route - at a younger age. That is self-reported and not verified by any records body.

verification: Live GPS tracking, publicly accessible, embeddable on a partner's own website.
Daily geotagged posts from the route, timestamped.
A stamped physical logbook, endorsed at post offices, police stations or district offices along the way.
Monthly written reports to sponsors: distance covered, content published, reach delivered, money spent.

standing.detail: A senior India Post officer, since promoted to Postmaster General of the Rajkot Region, has offered to help arrange accommodation at postal facilities. That is a personal offer of support and introductions, not a national institutional arrangement. Navneet is seeking it in writing.
Application submitted. No category for this record currently exists.
Journalists known to Navneet have indicated they will cover the start. Nothing is committed in writing.
Several creators have offered to amplify at launch.
This is the first round. Early partners get the cleanest association.

audience.who: Predominantly male, 18-35. Top cities Varanasi, Lucknow, Delhi.
audience.honestCaveat: About 500 posts, and a typical one gets a thousand views. Two of those 500 produced almost the entire following. The account is inconsistent - and when it connects, it connects hard.
audience.youtubeNote: the channel begins with the walk

deliverables.floor: 5 a month, built around the product
Backpack banner, tent and apparel, every walking day
Public GPS link, embeddable on your website
For attribution, if you want one

placement.detail: Primary placement, roughly 37 x 23 cm on the front of the pack. The surface in every photograph, every roadside conversation and every piece of press coverage.
Secondary placement for a supporting partner.
In every campsite frame and every morning-routine video, over 180 nights.
Chest and sleeve placement on walking shirts.
End-card on all twenty-plus monthly video pieces, plus link in bio.

tiers.name: Title Partner
tiers.includes: Everything. Primary logo placement on gear, tent and banner. Named as title partner across all content and press. 5 dedicated product features monthly. Named in the book. Full content library licensed. Category exclusivity.

tiers.name: Journey Partner
tiers.includes: Secondary logo placement. 2 dedicated product features monthly. Named in the book. Content library licensed.

tiers.name: Gear Partner
tiers.includes: Product instead of cash - footwear, tent, backpack, camera, power, apparel. Product-in-use content across the full walk, plus honest long-term reviews at 1,000, 2,500 and 4,000 km.

tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.includes: Named on the website and in the book. Logo in end-cards. Minimum participation.

terms: Payment: 100% on signing, or milestones against distance on request - 40% on signing, 30% at 1,500 km, 30% at 2,900 km.
Categories refused: alcohol, tobacco, betting, gambling, crypto speculation, or anything Navneet would not put in front of a nineteen-year-old reader.
Editorial: he will say true things about the product. If it fails at 2,000 km, he will say so. That is what makes the other 179 days credible.

risk.walkingIt: On foot, the whole way. If a stretch is impassable, he does not skip it - he resumes from the same point and walks that section. The GPS log is public throughout.
risk.pauses: A pause is not a failure. If injured he stops, treats it, and resumes from the point he stopped. A pause of any length is still one walk.
risk.ifItEnds: No cash refund - the money is committed to gear before departure and spent on food daily thereafter.
whatYouKeep: Every piece of content produced to that point, with a perpetual licence.
Every post stays live. Nothing is deleted.
Your name in the book, which is written whether the walk is completed or not.
Unused gear returned at his cost.

budget.inKind: ₹80,000 can be met with product rather than cash

lines.note: About ₹450 a day. Walking 27 km burns 4,000-5,000 calories.
Four pairs. Walking shoes last 800-1,200 km. In kind.
Tent, winter-rated sleeping bag, mat. In kind.
Power banks for remote stretches. In kind.

meetups.how: Free, no ticket, no RSVP. Where the road allows it people walk the last stretch into the city; where it does not, everyone gathers at a cafe. Announced in two stages - city and rough week two to three weeks ahead, exact time two to three days before.
meetups.forPartners: Send staff. Sample product. Set up a stall. Ten to fourteen cities with a physical touchpoint and no venue cost, because there is no venue.
meetups.honest: Nobody knows how many will come. The first may draw eight. What is committed is that at least ten happen, each announced and documented, with partners named in every post.

againstAdBudget.why: ₹2,00,000 buys 1.5 to 4 million impressions on Meta. This cannot promise anything near that. If cost per thousand impressions is your only metric, buy the ads.
Meta targets by age, city, interest and behaviour. This audience is who it is.
Meta reports clicks and conversions. Here it is a trackable link and a discount code, and that is the extent of it.
A campaign delivers in weeks. This delivers over six months.
Ads always run. A walker might get injured.

recommendation: Do not move money out of performance marketing to fund this. Fund it from the budget line that exists for brand association, sponsorship, or founder-led bets - the money that would otherwise go to a hoarding or an event with far less story in it.
